mapper.sql: id, phone, username, password_hash, name, role, county_code, town_code, village_code, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (phone, password_hash, name, role, county_code, town_code, village_code, created_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{role}, #{countyCode}, #{townCode}, #{villageCode}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE username = 'admin' AND role IN ('VILLAGE_ADMIN', 'TOWN_ADMIN', 'SYS_ADMIN')
